text:
Counting the grapes on the plate gives about 22. They look like red grapes, and a few are greenish.

Each grape looks medium-sized, around 5 g, so the total mass is roughly 22 × 5 = 110 g.

Grapes have about 0.69 kcal per gram, so 110 g × 0.69 ≈ 76 kcal.
